name: JCB Dieselmax
summary: The JCB Dieselmax is a streamliner car designed for the purpose of breaking the land speed record for a diesel-engined vehicle. The car was built for JCB, a British multinational equipment company. As of 2018, the car holds the world diesel-powered land speed record, having been driven to over 350 miles per hour (560 km/h) by Wing Commander Andy Green in 2006.

engine.value: Two JCB444 common rail injection diesel engines with twin compound turbochargers and intercoolers

transmission.value: Forward transmission and final drive connected to forward engine; rear transmission and final drive unit connected to rear engine

height.value: 0.98 m to canopy; 1.34 m to fin tip
